market_question: Will another country leave OPEC in 2026?
reasoning: UAE’s exit is a shock, but OPEC exits are rare and usually driven by long-term grievances; the short window (Apr–Dec 2026) reduces the chance of another country formally announcing withdrawal. Historical annual exit probability is ~10–15%, and while contagion raises it, 31.5% implies a near-certainty that doesn’t match the deliberate pace of such decisions.
evidence_points: Only 8 months remain in 2026 after UAE’s announcement, limiting exposure.
OPEC exits since 2019 (Qatar, Ecuador, Angola) average less than one per year.
Most remaining members (e.g., Iraq, Kuwait) have strong reliance on OPEC coordination with Saudi Arabia.
No public signals from other members indicating imminent exit plans as of mid-2026.
sources_consulted: Historical OPEC membership data (Reuters, OPEC statements)
General geopolitical reasoning on energy alliances
